prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. An old man with short grey hair on a bare head, in a plain brown wool robe belted with a rope, barefoot, seen from behind, his face never visible, stands at a small square opening of rough pitch-black planks and opens his cupped hands as a white dove lifts out of them into the grey sky over the water. Grey morning light. Hopeful and grave. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
